items.question: Can the prescribed practice truly bring about certain pacification of disease?
premises: Pacification of disease may result from the practice.
This stated outcome is affirmed as true.
No doubt exists regarding this outcome.
items.inference: Therefore the efficacy of the prescribed practice in pacifying disease is asserted as certain.
items.plain_english: Truly, pacification of disease will occur; of this there is no doubt.
